work_items.description: Blocker: HTTP Route Configs cannot replace app-proxy while auth-proxy sidecar dependency exists The current architecture runs auth-proxy and app-proxy as a tightly coupled pair in the same container. The auth-proxy is hardwired to forward all authenticated requests to the app-proxy running locally alongside it. Removing the app-proxy sidecar, as required by the HTTP Route Configs migration, leaves the auth-proxy with no forwarding target, causing a complete application outage. The migration cannot proceed without first resolving this architectural dependency.

work_items.description: FYI @ABASSI Chifa   @KHEMIRI Karima Strategic Technical Analysis: MES Data Architecture & Risk Mitigation 1. Impact Analysis: JSON Storage Performance Binary Efficiency (JSONB) vs. Text Parsing The primary disadvantage of traditional SQL Server is its text-based JSON handling ( NVARCHAR ). In that environment, every query requires the engine to parse a string from scratch to find a value. In contrast, PostgreSQL utilizes JSONB (Binary JSON) . Storage Optimization: PostgreSQL stores data in a pre-parsed binary format. Impact: This eliminates the "Query Complexity" and "CPU Overhead" found in SQL Server, allowing for NoSQL-like retrieval speeds within a robust relational framework. Update Performance & Atomic Operations In SQL Server, updating a single field

# Use the Azure DevOps pipeline templates
resources:
  repositories:
    - repository: 'pipelines'
      type: 'git'
      name: 'Azure/template-pipelines'

trigger:
  batch: true
  branches:
    include:
      - develop
      - master
      - main

jobs:
  - template: jobs/sonar-process.yml@pipelines
    parameters:
      agent_pool: ubuntu-2204-vmss-mesx
      prepare_scanner_mode: CLI
      prepare_sonarExclusions: $(Build.SourcesDirectory)/node_modules/**
      prepare_sonarAdditionalProperties: |
        sonar.sources=$(Build.SourcesDirectory)/src
        sonar.test.inclusions=**/*.spec.ts
        sonar.tests=$(Build.SourcesDirectory)/src
        sonar.typescript.tsconfigPath=$(Build.SourcesDirectory)/tsconfig.lint.json

      step_postPrepare:
        - template: steps/angular-lint-and-test.yaml@pipelines
          parameters:
            nodejs_version: 20.x
            run_unit_tests: false

        - template: steps/sonarqube-reports.yml@pipelines
          parameters:
            reports:
              - name: sonar.junit.reportPaths
                path: $(Build.SourcesDirectory)/coverage/junit-tests.xml
              - name: sonar.eslint.reportPaths
                path: $(Build.SourcesDirectory)/report.json
              - name: sonar.testExecutionReportPaths
                path: $(Build.SourcesDirectory)/coverage/sonar-tests.xml
              - name: sonar.flex.cobertura.reportPaths
                path: $(Build.SourcesDirectory)/coverage/cobertura-coverage.xml
              - name: sonar.javascript.lcov.reportPaths
                path: $(Build.SourcesDirectory)/coverage/lcov.info
              - name: sonar.css.stylelint.reportPaths
                path: $(Build.SourcesDirectory)/stylelint.json

/**
 * Convert a language code to an ISO country code used for flag icons.
 * @param code language code (e.g. 'en', 'en_US')
 * @returns lowercase country code suitable for flag CSS classes (e.g. 'us'), or
 * an empty string when no mapping is available
 */
export function langCodeToCountry(code: string): string {
  if (!code) return '';
  const normalized = String(code).replace('_', '-').toUpperCase();
  const mapEntries: Array<[string, string]> = [
    ['AF', 'za'],
    ['AR', 'sa'],
    ['BN', 'bd'],
    ['CS', 'cz'],
    ['DA', 'dk'],
    ['DE', 'de'],
    ['EN', 'us'],
    ['ES', 'es'],
    ['FA', 'ir'],
    ['FI', 'fi'],
    ['FR', 'fr'],
    ['HI', 'in'],
    ['HU', 'hu'],
    ['ID', 'id'],
    ['IT', 'it'],
    ['JA', 'jp'],
    ['KO', 'kr'],
    ['MS', 'my'],
    ['NL', 'nl'],
    ['NO', 'no'],
    ['PL', 'pl'],
    ['PT', 'pt'],
    ['RO', 'ro'],
    ['RU', 'ru'],
    ['SV', 'se'],
    ['SW', 'ke'],
    ['TH', 'th'],
    ['TR', 'tr'],
    ['VI', 'vn'],
    ['ZH', 'cn'],
  ];
  const map: Record<string, string> = Object.fromEntries(mapEntries);
  if (map[normalized]) return map[normalized];
  const prefix = normalized.split('-')[0];
  return map[prefix] ?? '';
}

/**
 * Build the flag CSS class for a language code.
 * @param code language code
 * @returns a flag CSS class like 'fi fi-us' or an empty string when not found
 */
export function getLanguageFlag(code: string): string {
  const cc = langCodeToCountry(code ?? '');
  return cc ? `fi fi-${cc}` : '';
}

/**
 * Resolve the human-readable language name from a language code.
 * @param code language code to resolve
 * @returns the language display name when found, otherwise returns the
 * original code value
 */
export function getLanguageName(code: string): string {
  const lang = languages.find(
    (l) =>
      l.code === code.toUpperCase() || l.code.startsWith(code.toUpperCase()),
  );
  return lang ? lang.name : code;
}

            $rg = 'rg-gptmpxn01-dev-eun-mes-01'
          } elseif ($env -eq 'ppr') {
            $rg = 'rg-gptmpxp01-ppr-eun-mes-01'

            $rg = 'rg-gptmpxp01-pro-euw-mes-01'

          }

          $WaitingDelayInSeconds = ${{ parameters.migrationsWaitingDelayInSeconds }}
          $RetryCount = ${{ parameters.migrationWaitingRetryCount }}

          $resources = az resource list -g $rg -o json `
            | ConvertFrom-Json

          $migrationsJobs = $resources `
              | Where-Object {
                  $_.name.EndsWith('-dbm') -and ($_.type -eq 'Microsoft.App/jobs')
              }

          Write-Output 'The following jobs will be triggered:'
          $migrationsJobs | ForEach-Object { Write-Output "- $($_.name)" }

          Write-Output 'Triggering Migration Jobs...'
          $jobExecutions = $migrationsJobs `
              | ForEach-Object {
                  $executionName = az containerapp job start `
                      -n $_.name `
                      -g $rg `
                      --query name -o tsv
                  return [PSCustomObject]@{
                      JobName = $_.name
                      ResourceGroupName = $rg
                      ExecutionName = $executionName
                  }     
              }

          Write-Output 'Start Waiting Jobs...'
          $waitingJobs = $jobExecutions `
              | ForEach-Object {
                  Start-Job -Name $_.ExecutionName `
                      -ScriptBlock { 
                          param(
                              $jobExec,
                              $delay,
                              $retryCount
                          )

                          function Get-JobExecutionStatus {
                              param(
                                  $JobExecution
                              )
                          
                              return az containerapp job execution show `
                                  -n $JobExecution.JobName `
                                  -g $JobExecution.ResourceGroupName `
                                  --job-execution-name $JobExecution.ExecutionName `
                                  --query properties.status -o tsv
                          }
                          
                          function Wait-JobCompletion {
                              param(
                                  $JobExecution,
                                  $DelaySeconds,
                                  $RetryCount,
                                  $SuccessStatus = 'Succeeded',
                                  $WaitingStatuses = @('Unknown', 'Running')
                              )
                          
                              $jobStatus = Get-JobExecutionStatus $JobExecution
                          
                              while ($WaitingStatuses.Contains($jobStatus) -and ($RetryCount -gt 0)) {
                                  Write-Output "$(Date -Format 'yyyy-MM-dd hh:mm:ss') - Running, remaining retries $RetryCount..."
                                  Start-Sleep -Seconds $DelaySeconds
                                  $jobStatus = Get-JobExecutionStatus $JobExecution
                                  $RetryCount -= 1
                              }


                              if ($jobstatus -ne $SuccessStatus) {
                                  throw "Migration Job did not complete successfully or timed out, status: $jobStatus, remaining retries: $RetryCount"
                              }
                            
                              Write-Output "Migration Job '$($JobExecution.ExecutionName)' completed successfully !"
                          }

                          Wait-JobCompletion $jobExec $delay $retryCount
                      } `
                      -ArgumentList $_, $WaitingDelayInSeconds, $RetryCount
              }

          $waitingJobs `
              | ForEach-Object {
                  Write-Output "$($_.Name) output:"
                  Receive-Job $_ -Wait
              }

  # -- When providers.kubernetesGateway.enabled, deploy a default gateway
  enabled: true
  # -- Set a custom name to gateway
  name: ""
  # -- By default, Gateway is created in the same `Namespace` than Traefik.
  namespace: ""
  # -- Additional gateway annotations (e.g. for cert-manager.io/issuer)
  annotations: {}
  # -- [Infrastructure](https://kubernetes.io/blog/2023/11/28/gateway-api-ga/#gateway-infrastructure-labels)
  infrastructure: {}
  # -- Define listeners
  listeners:
    web:
      # -- Port is the network port. Multiple listeners may use the same port, subject to the Listener compatibility rules.
      # The port must match a port declared in ports section.
      port: 8000
      # -- Optional hostname. See [Hostname](https://gateway-api.sigs.k8s.io/reference/spec/#gateway.networking.k8s.io/v1.Hostname)
      hostname: ""
      # Specify expected protocol on this listener. See [ProtocolType](https://gateway-api.sigs.k8s.io/reference/spec/#gateway.networking.k8s.io/v1.ProtocolType)
      protocol: HTTP
      # -- Routes are restricted to namespace of the gateway [by default](https://gateway-api.sigs.k8s.io/reference/spec/#gateway.networking.k8s.io/v1.FromNamespaces
      namespacePolicy:  # @schema type:[string, null]
    # websecure listener is disabled by default because certificateRefs needs to be added,
    # or you may specify TLS protocol with Passthrough mode and add "--providers.kubernetesGateway.experimentalChannel=true" in additionalArguments section.
    # websecure:
    #   # -- Port is the network port. Multiple listeners may use the same port, subject to the Listener compatibility rules.
    #   # The port must match a port declared in ports section.
    #   port: 8443
    #   # -- Optional hostname. See [Hostname](https://gateway-api.sigs.k8s.io/reference/spec/#gateway.networking.k8s.io/v1.Hostname)
    #   hostname:
    #   # Specify expected protocol on this listener See [ProtocolType](https://gateway-api.sigs.k8s.io/reference/spec/#gateway.networking.k8s.io/v1.ProtocolType)
    #   protocol: HTTPS
    #   # -- Routes are restricted to namespace of the gateway [by default](https://gateway-api.sigs.k8s.io/reference/spec/#gateway.networking.k8s.io/v1.FromNamespaces)
    #   namespacePolicy:
    #   # -- Add certificates for TLS or HTTPS protocols. See [GatewayTLSConfig](https://gateway-api.sigs.k8s.io/reference/spec/#gateway.networking.k8s.io%2fv1.GatewayTLSConfig)
    #   certificateRefs:
    #   # -- TLS behavior for the TLS session initiated by the client. See [TLSModeType](https://gateway-api.sigs.k8s.io/reference/spec/#gateway.networking.k8s.io/v1.TLSModeType).
    #   mode:

gatewayClass:  # @schema additionalProperties: false
  # -- When providers.kubernetesGateway.enabled and gateway.enabled, deploy a default gatewayClass
  enabled: true
  # -- Set a custom name to GatewayClass
  name: ""
  # -- Additional gatewayClass labels (e.g. for filtering gateway objects by custom labels)
  labels: {}

ingressRoute:
  dashboard:
    # -- Create an IngressRoute for the dashboard
    enabled: false
    # -- Additional ingressRoute annotations (e.g. for kubernetes.io/ingress.class)
    annotations: {}
    # -- Additional ingressRoute labels (e.g. for filtering IngressRoute by custom labels)
    labels: {}
    # -- The router match rule used for the dashboard ingressRoute
    matchRule: PathPrefix(`/dashboard`) || PathPrefix(`/api`)
    # -- The internal service used for the dashboard ingressRoute
    services:
      - name: api@internal
        kind: TraefikService
    # -- Specify the allowed entrypoints to use for the dashboard ingress route, (e.g. traefik, web, websecure).
    # By default, it's using traefik entrypoint, which is not exposed.
    # /!\ Do not expose your dashboard without any protection over the internet /!\
    entryPoints: ["traefik", "web", "websecure"]
    # -- Additional ingressRoute middlewares (e.g. for authentication)
    middlewares: []
    # -- TLS options (e.g. secret containing certificate)
    tls: {}
  healthcheck:
    # -- Create an IngressRoute for the healthcheck probe
    enabled: false
    # -- Additional ingressRoute annotations (e.g. for kubernetes.io/ingress.class)
    annotations: {}
    # -- Additional ingressRoute labels (e.g. for filtering IngressRoute by custom labels)
    labels: {}
    # -- The router match rule used for the healthcheck ingressRoute
    matchRule: PathPrefix(`/ping`)
    # -- The internal service used for the healthcheck ingressRoute
    services:
      - name: ping@internal
        kind: TraefikService
    # -- Specify the allowed entrypoints to use for the healthcheck ingress route, (e.g. traefik, web, websecure).
    # By default, it's using traefik entrypoint, which is not exposed.
    entryPoints: ["traefik"]
    # -- Additional ingressRoute middlewares (e.g. for authentication)
    middlewares: []
    # -- TLS options (e.g. secret containing certificate)
    tls: {}

updateStrategy:  # @schema additionalProperties: false
  # -- Customize updateStrategy of Deployment or DaemonSet
  type: RollingUpdate
  rollingUpdate:
    maxUnavailable: 0  # @schema type:[integer, string, null]
    maxSurge: 1        # @schema type:[integer, string, null]

readinessProbe:  # @schema additionalProperties: false
  # -- The number of consecutive failures allowed before considering the probe as failed.
  failureThreshold: 1
  # -- The number of seconds to wait before starting the first probe.
  initialDelaySeconds: 2
  # -- The number of seconds to wait between consecutive probes.
  periodSeconds: 10
  # -- The minimum consecutive successes required to consider the probe successful.
  successThreshold: 1
  # -- The number of seconds to wait for a probe response before considering it as failed.
  timeoutSeconds: 2
livenessProbe:  # @schema additionalProperties: false
  # -- The number of consecutive failures allowed before considering the probe as failed.
  failureThreshold: 3
  # -- The number of seconds to wait before starting the first probe.
  initialDelaySeconds: 2
  # -- The number of seconds to wait between consecutive probes.
  periodSeconds: 10
  # -- The minimum consecutive successes required to consider the probe successful.
  successThreshold: 1
  # -- The number of seconds to wait for a probe response before considering it as failed.
  timeoutSeconds: 2

# -- Define [Startup Probe](https://kubernetes.io/docs/tasks/configure-pod-container/configure-liveness-readiness-startup-probes/#define-startup-probes)
startupProbe: {}

providers:  # @schema additionalProperties: false
  kubernetesCRD:
    # -- Load Kubernetes IngressRoute provider
    enabled: true
    # -- Allows IngressRoute to reference resources in namespace other than theirs
    allowCrossNamespace: false
    # -- Allows to reference ExternalName services in IngressRoute
    allowExternalNameServices: false
    # -- Allows to return 503 when there is no endpoints available
    allowEmptyServices: true
    # -- When the parameter is set, only resources containing an annotation with the same value are processed. Otherwise, resources missing the annotation, having an empty value, or the value traefik are processed. It will also set required annotation on Dashboard and Healthcheck IngressRoute when enabled.
    ingressClass: ""
    # labelSelector: environment=production,method=traefik
    # -- Array of namespaces to watch. If left empty, Traefik watches all namespaces. . When using `rbac.namespaced`, it will watch helm release namespace and namespaces listed in this array.
    namespaces: []
    # -- Defines whether to use Native Kubernetes load-balancing mode by default.
    nativeLBByDefault: false

  kubernetesIngress:
    # -- Load Kubernetes Ingress provider
    enabled: true
    # -- Allows to reference ExternalName services in Ingress
    allowExternalNameServices: false
    # -- Allows to return 503 when there is no endpoints available
    allowEmptyServices: true
    # -- When ingressClass is set, only Ingresses containing an annotation with the same value are processed. Otherwise, Ingresses missing the annotation, having an empty value, or the value traefik are processed.
    ingressClass:  # @schema type:[string, null]
    # labelSelector: environment=production,method=traefik
    # -- Array of namespaces to watch. If left empty, Traefik watches all namespaces. . When using `rbac.namespaced`, it will watch helm release namespace and namespaces listed in this array.
    namespaces: []
    # IP used for Kubernetes Ingress endpoints
    publishedService:
      # -- Enable [publishedService](https://doc.traefik.io/traefik/providers/kubernetes-ingress/#publishedservice)
      enabled: true
      # -- Override path of Kubernetes Service used to copy status from. Format: namespace/servicename.
      # Default to Service deployed with this Chart.
      pathOverride: ""
    # -- Defines whether to use Native Kubernetes load-balancing mode by default.
    nativeLBByDefault: false

  kubernetesGateway:
    # -- Enable Traefik Gateway provider for Gateway API
    enabled: false
    # -- Toggles support for the Experimental Channel resources (Gateway API release channels documentation).
    # This option currently enables support for TCPRoute and TLSRoute.
    experimentalChannel: false
    # -- Array of namespaces to watch. If left empty, Traefik watches all namespaces. . When using `rbac.namespaced`, it will watch helm release namespace and namespaces listed in this array.
    namespaces: []
    # -- A label selector can be defined to filter on specific GatewayClass objects only.
    labelselector: ""
    # -- Defines whether to use Native Kubernetes load-balancing mode by default.
    nativeLBByDefault: false
    statusAddress:
      # -- This IP will get copied to the Gateway status.addresses, and currently only supports one IP value (IPv4 or IPv6).
      ip: ""
      # -- This Hostname will get copied to the Gateway status.addresses.
      hostname: ""
      # -- The Kubernetes service to copy status addresses from. When using third parties tools like External-DNS, this option can be used to copy the service loadbalancer.status (containing the service's endpoints IPs) to the gateways. Default to Service of this Chart.
      service:
        enabled: true
        name: ""
        namespace: ""

  file:
    # -- Create a file provider
    enabled: false
    # -- Allows Traefik to automatically watch for file changes
    watch: true
    # -- File content (YAML format, go template supported) (see https://doc.traefik.io/traefik/providers/file/)
    content: ""

# -- Add volumes to the traefik pod. The volume name will be passed to tpl.
# This can be used to mount a cert pair or a configmap that holds a config.toml file.
# After the volume has been mounted, add the configs into traefik by using the `additionalArguments` list below, eg:
# `additionalArguments:
# - "--providers.file.filename=/config/dynamic.toml"
# - "--ping"
# - "--ping.entrypoint=web"`
volumes: []
# - name: public-cert
#   mountPath: "/certs"
#   type: secret
# - name: '{{ printf "%s-configs" .Release.Name }}'
#   mountPath: "/config"
#   type: configMap

# -- Additional volumeMounts to add to the Traefik container
additionalVolumeMounts: []
# -- For instance when using a logshipper for access logs
# - name: traefik-logs
#   mountPath: /var/log/traefik

logs:
  general:
    # -- Set [logs format](https://doc.traefik.io/traefik/observability/logs/#format)
    format:  # @schema enum:["common", "json", null]; type:[string, null]; default: "common"
    # By default, the level is set to INFO.
    # -- Alternative logging levels are TRACE, DEBUG, INFO, WARN, ERROR, FATAL, and PANIC.
    level: "INFO"  # @schema enum:[TRACE,DEBUG,INFO,WARN,ERROR,FATAL,PANIC]; default: "INFO"
    # -- To write the logs into a log file, use the filePath option.
    filePath: ""
    # -- When set to true and format is common, it disables the colorized output.
    noColor: false
  access:
    # -- To enable access logs
    enabled: false
    # -- Set [access log format](https://doc.traefik.io/traefik/observability/access-logs/#format)
    format:  # @schema enum:["common", "json", null]; type:[string, null]; default: "common"
    # filePath: "/var/log/traefik/access.log
    # -- Set [bufferingSize](https://doc.traefik.io/traefik/observability/access-logs/#bufferingsize)
    bufferingSize:  # @schema type:[integer, null]
    # -- Set [filtering](https://docs.traefik.io/observability/access-logs/#filtering)
    filters:  # @schema additionalProperties: false
      # -- Set statusCodes, to limit the access logs to requests with a status codes in the specified range
      statuscodes: ""
      # -- Set retryAttempts, to keep the access logs when at least one retry has happened
      retryattempts: false
      # -- Set minDuration, to keep access logs when requests take longer than the specified duration
      minduration: ""
    # -- Enables accessLogs for internal resources. Default: false.
    addInternals: false
    fields:
      general:
        # -- Set default mode for fields.names
        defaultmode: keep  # @schema enum:[keep, drop, redact]; default: keep
        # -- Names of the fields to limit.
        names: {}
      # -- [Limit logged fields or headers](https://doc.traefik.io/traefik/observability/access-logs/#limiting-the-fieldsincluding-headers)
      headers:
        # -- Set default mode for fields.headers
        defaultmode: drop  # @schema enum:[keep, drop, redact]; default: drop
        names: {}

metrics:
  # -- Enable metrics for internal resources. Default: false
  addInternals: false

  ## Prometheus is enabled by default.
  ## It can be disabled by setting "prometheus: null"
  prometheus:
    # -- Entry point used to expose metrics.
    entryPoint: metrics
    # -- Enable metrics on entry points. Default: true
    addEntryPointsLabels:  # @schema type:[boolean, null]
    # -- Enable metrics on routers. Default: false
    addRoutersLabels:  # @schema type:[boolean, null]
    # -- Enable metrics on services. Default: true
    addServicesLabels:  # @schema type:[boolean, null]
    # -- Buckets for latency metrics. Default="0.1,0.3,1.2,5.0"
    buckets: ""
    # -- When manualRouting is true, it disables the default internal router in
    ## order to allow creating a custom router for prometheus@internal service.
    manualRouting: false
    # -- Add HTTP header labels to metrics. See EXAMPLES.md or upstream doc for usage.
    headerLabels: {}  # @schema type:[object, null]
    service:
      # -- Create a dedicated metrics service to use with ServiceMonitor
      enabled: false
      labels: {}
      annotations: {}
    # -- When set to true, it won't check if Prometheus Operator CRDs are deployed
    disableAPICheck:  # @schema type:[boolean, null]
    serviceMonitor:
      # -- Enable optional CR for Prometheus Operator. See EXAMPLES.md for more details.
      enabled: false
      metricRelabelings: []
      relabelings: []
      jobLabel: ""
      interval: ""
      honorLabels: false
      scrapeTimeout: ""
      honorTimestamps: false
      enableHttp2: false
      followRedirects: false
      additionalLabels: {}
      namespace: ""
      namespaceSelector: {}
    prometheusRule:
      # -- Enable optional CR for Prometheus Operator. See EXAMPLES.md for more details.
      enabled: false
      additionalLabels: {}
      namespace: ""

  #  datadog:
  #    ## Address instructs exporter to send metrics to datadog-agent at this address.
  #    address: "127.0.0.1:8125"
  #    ## The interval used by the exporter to push metrics to datadog-agent. Default=10s
  #    # pushInterval: 30s
  #    ## The prefix to use for metrics collection. Default="traefik"
  #    # prefix: traefik
  #    ## Enable metrics on entry points. Default=true
  #    # addEntryPointsLabels: false
  #    ## Enable metrics on routers. Default=false
  #    # addRoutersLabels: true

  #    # addServicesLabels: false
  #  influxdb2:
  #    ## Address instructs exporter to send metrics to influxdb v2 at this address.
  #    address: localhost:8086
  #    ## Token with which to connect to InfluxDB v2.
  #    token: xxx
  #    ## Organisation where metrics will be stored.
  #    org: ""
  #    ## Bucket where metrics will be stored.
  #    bucket: ""
  #    ## The interval used by the exporter to push metrics to influxdb. Default=10s
  #    # pushInterval: 30s
  #    ## Additional labels (influxdb tags) on all metrics.
  #    # additionalLabels:
  #    #   env: production
  #    #   foo: bar
  #    ## Enable metrics on entry points. Default=true
  #    # addEntryPointsLabels: false
  #    ## Enable metrics on routers. Default=false
  #    # addRoutersLabels: true
  #    ## Enable metrics on services. Default=true
  #    # addServicesLabels: false
  #  statsd:
  #    ## Address instructs exporter to send metrics to statsd at this address.
  #    address: localhost:8125
  #    ## The interval used by the exporter to push metrics to influxdb. Default=10s
  #    # pushInterval: 30s
  #    ## The prefix to use for metrics collection. Default="traefik"
  #    # prefix: traefik
  #    ## Enable metrics on entry points. Default=true
  #    # addEntryPointsLabels: false
  #    ## Enable metrics on routers. Default=false
  #    # addRoutersLabels: true
  #    ## Enable metrics on services. Default=true
  #    # addServicesLabels: false
  otlp:
    # -- Set to true in order to enable the OpenTelemetry metrics
    enabled: false
    # -- Enable metrics on entry points. Default: true
    addEntryPointsLabels:  # @schema type:[boolean, null]
    # -- Enable metrics on routers. Default: false
    addRoutersLabels:  # @schema type:[boolean, null]
    # -- Enable metrics on services. Default: true
    addServicesLabels:  # @schema type:[boolean, null]
    # -- Explicit boundaries for Histogram data points. Default: [.005, .01, .025, .05, .1, .25, .5, 1, 2.5, 5, 10]
    explicitBoundaries: []
    # -- Interval at which metrics are sent to the OpenTelemetry Collector. Default: 10s
    pushInterval: ""
    http:
      # -- Set to true in order to send metrics to the OpenTelemetry Collector using HTTP.
      enabled: false
      # -- Format: <scheme>://<host>:<port><path>. Default: http://localhost:4318/v1/metrics
      endpoint: ""
      # -- Additional headers sent with metrics by the reporter to the OpenTelemetry Collector.
      headers: {}
      ## Defines the TLS configuration used by the reporter to send metrics to the OpenTelemetry Collector.
      tls:
        # -- The path to the certificate authority, it defaults to the system bundle.
        ca: ""
        # -- The path to the public certificate. When using this option, setting the key option is required.
        cert: ""
        # -- The path to the private key. When using this option, setting the cert option is required.
        key: ""
        # -- When set to true, the TLS connection accepts any certificate presented by the server regardless of the hostnames it covers.
        insecureSkipVerify:  # @schema type:[boolean, null]
    grpc:
      # -- Set to true in order to send metrics to the OpenTelemetry Collector using gRPC
      enabled: false
      # -- Format: <scheme>://<host>:<port><path>. Default: http://localhost:4318/v1/metrics
      endpoint: ""
      # -- Allows reporter to send metrics to the OpenTelemetry Collector without using a secured protocol.
      insecure: false
      ## Defines the TLS configuration used by the reporter to send metrics to the OpenTelemetry Collector.
      tls:
        # -- The path to the certificate authority, it defaults to the system bundle.
        ca: ""
        # -- The path to the public certificate. When using this option, setting the key option is required.
        cert: ""
        # -- The path to the private key. When using this option, setting the cert option is required.
        key: ""
        # -- When set to true, the TLS connection accepts any certificate presented by the server regardless of the hostnames it covers.
        insecureSkipVerify: false

# -- Global command arguments to be passed to all traefik's pods
globalArguments:
- "--global.checknewversion"
- "--global.sendanonymoususage"

# -- Additional arguments to be passed at Traefik's binary
# See [CLI Reference](https://docs.traefik.io/reference/static-configuration/cli/)
# Use curly braces to pass values: `helm install --set="additionalArguments={--providers.kubernetesingress.ingressclass=traefik-internal,--log.level=DEBUG}"`
additionalArguments: []
#  - "--providers.kubernetesingress.ingressclass=traefik-internal"
#  - "--log.level=DEBUG"

# -- Additional Environment variables to be passed to Traefik's binary
# @default -- See _values.yaml_
env: []

# -- Environment variables to be passed to Traefik's binary from configMaps or secrets
envFrom: []

ports:
  traefik:
    port: 8080
    # -- Use hostPort if set.
    hostPort:  # @schema type:[integer, null]; minimum:0
    # -- Use hostIP if set. If not set, Kubernetes will default to 0.0.0.0, which
    # means it's listening on all your interfaces and all your IPs. You may want
    # to set this value if you need traefik to listen on specific interface
    # only.
    hostIP:  # @schema type:[string, null]

    # Defines whether the port is exposed if service.type is LoadBalancer or
    # NodePort.
    #
    # -- You SHOULD NOT expose the traefik port on production deployments.
    # If you want to access it from outside your cluster,
    # use `kubectl port-forward` or create a secure ingress
    expose:
      default: false
    # -- The exposed port for this service
    exposedPort: 8080
    # -- The port protocol (TCP/UDP)
    protocol: TCP
  web:
    ## -- Enable this entrypoint as a default entrypoint. When a service doesn't explicitly set an entrypoint it will only use this entrypoint.
    # asDefault: true
    port: 8000
    # hostPort: 8000
    # containerPort: 8000
    expose:
      default: true
    exposedPort: 80
    ## -- Different target traefik port on the cluster, useful for IP type LB
    targetPort:  # @schema type:[string, integer, null]; minimum:0
    # The port protocol (TCP/UDP)
    protocol: TCP
    # -- See [upstream documentation](https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/services-networking/service/#type-nodeport)
    nodePort:  # @schema type:[integer, null]; minimum:0
    redirections:
      # -- Port Redirections
      # Added in 2.2, one can make permanent redirects via entrypoints.
      # Same sets of parameters: to, scheme, permanent and priority.
      # https://docs.traefik.io/routing/entrypoints/#redirection
      entryPoint: {}
    forwardedHeaders:
      # -- Trust forwarded headers information (X-Forwarded-*).
      trustedIPs: []
      insecure: false
    proxyProtocol:
      # -- Enable the Proxy Protocol header parsing for the entry point
      trustedIPs: []
      insecure: false
    # -- Set transport settings for the entrypoint; see also
    # https://doc.traefik.io/traefik/routing/entrypoints/#transport
    transport:
      respondingTimeouts:
        readTimeout:   # @schema type:[string, integer, null]
        writeTimeout:  # @schema type:[string, integer, null]
        idleTimeout:   # @schema type:[string, integer, null]
      lifeCycle:
        requestAcceptGraceTimeout:  # @schema type:[string, integer, null]
        graceTimeOut:               # @schema type:[string, integer, null]
      keepAliveMaxRequests:         # @schema type:[integer, null]; minimum:0
      keepAliveMaxTime:             # @schema type:[string, integer, null]
  websecure:
    ## -- Enable this entrypoint as a default entrypoint. When a service doesn't explicitly set an entrypoint it will only use this entrypoint.
    # asDefault: true
    port: 8443
    hostPort:  # @schema type:[integer, null]; minimum:0
    containerPort:  # @schema type:[integer, null]; minimum:0
    expose:
      default: true
    exposedPort: 443
    ## -- Different target traefik port on the cluster, useful for IP type LB
    targetPort:  # @schema type:[string, integer, null]; minimum:0
    ## -- The port protocol (TCP/UDP)
    protocol: TCP
    # -- See [upstream documentation](https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/services-networking/service/#type-nodeport)
    nodePort:  # @schema type:[integer, null]; minimum:0
    # -- See [upstream documentation](https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/services-networking/service/#application-protocol)
    appProtocol:  # @schema type:[string, null]
    # -- See [upstream documentation](https://doc.traefik.io/traefik/routing/entrypoints/#allowacmebypass)
    allowACMEByPass: false
    http3:
      ## -- Enable HTTP/3 on the entrypoint
      ## Enabling it will also enable http3 experimental feature
      ## https://doc.traefik.io/traefik/routing/entrypoints/#http3
      ## There are known limitations when trying to listen on same ports for

apiVersion: v2
name: mesx-edge-api-proto
description: MES X.0 Edge Service Prototype
icon: https://helm.sh/assets/images/helm-logo.svg
version: 0.0.53
sources:
  - https://dev.azure.com/faurecia-cloud/MES_X.0/_git/mesx-proto-edge-api
  - https://dev.azure.com/faurecia-cloud/MES_X.0/_git/mesx-infrastructure-helm
maintainers:
  - name: MES X.0 Team
    email: DL-MES-CC-DEV@faurecia.com

trigger:
  tags:
    include:
    - '*'
  branches:
    include:
      - main
  paths:
    include:
      - mesx-edge-api-proto/**
    exclude:
      - mesx-edge-api-proto/README.md

resources:
  repositories:
    - repository: templates
      type: git
      name: mpx/mpx-pipeline-templates
      ref: refs/heads/main

    - repository: mesx-ops-pipelines
      type: git
      name: MES_X.0/mesx-ops-pipelines
      ref: refs/heads/main

variables:
  isPR: $[eq(variables['Build.Reason'], 'PullRequest')]
  triggeredOnTag: $[and(eq(variables.isPR, false), startsWith(variables['Build.SourceBranch'], 'refs/tags/'))]
  chartFolder: mesx-edge-api-proto

stages:
  - stage: checkVersion
    displayName: 'Helm Check Version'
    jobs:
    - job: checkVersion
      condition: eq(variables.triggeredOnTag, 'True')
      displayName: 'Helm Check Version'
      pool:
        vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'
      steps:
      - checkout: self
        clean: true
        fetchTags: true
        fetchDepth: 0
      
      - template: build/steps/steps-semver-check-semver.yml@mesx-ops-pipelines
      - task: PowerShell@2
        displayName: 'Check Chart Version Matches Tag'
        inputs:
          targetType: 'inline'
          script: |
            $chartVersion = (Get-Content $(chartFolder)/Chart.yaml | Select-String -Pattern '\bversion:').ToString().Split(':')[1].Trim()
            $currentTag = "$(Build.SourceBranchName)" -replace 'refs/tags/', ''
            
            if ($chartVersion -ne $currentTag) {
              Write-Host "Chart version '$chartVersion' does not match tag '$currentTag'."
              Write-Host "Please make sure the version specified in Chart.yaml matches the tag used to release the stable version."
              throw "Chart version and tag mismatch"
            } else {
              Write-Host "Chart version '$chartVersion' matches tag '$currentTag'."
            }
          workingDirectory: '$(System.DefaultWorkingDirectory)'
  - stage: build
    displayName: 'Build and Push Helm Chart'
    jobs:
    - template: build/jobs/pack-and-push-helm-chart.yml@templates
      parameters:
        jobPool: ubuntu-2204-vmss-mesx
        chartFolder: $(chartFolder)
        helmPushSubscription: spn-dev-inf-mes
        publish: $(triggeredOnTag)

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: mesx-{{ .Values.env }}-edge-api-proto
  labels:
      app: 'mesx'
      chart: 'mesx-edge-api-proto'
      release: {{ .Release.Name }}
      component: edge-api-proto
spec:
  strategy:
    type: RollingUpdate
  replicas: {{ .Values.replicas }}
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: 'mesx'
      release: {{ .Release.Name }}
      component: edge-api-proto
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: 'mesx'
        release: {{ .Release.Name }}
        component: edge-api-proto
      annotations:
        dapr.io/enabled: "true"
        dapr.io/app-id: "{{ .Values.appconfig.appId }}"
        dapr.io/app-port: "{{ .Values.appconfig.appPort }}"
        dapr.io/enable-api-logging: "false"
    spec:
      serviceAccountName: {{ .Values.serviceAccount }}
      containers:
        - image: "{{ .Values.image }}:{{ pluck .Values.env .Values.serviceVersions.edge_api_proto | first | default .Values.serviceVersions.edge_api_proto.dev }}"
          imagePullPolicy: Always
          name: edge-api-proto
          ports:
            - containerPort: {{ .Values.appconfig.appPort }}
          env:
          - name: MESSAGE
            value: '{{ .Values.appconfig.message }}'
          - name: APP_PORT
            value: '{{ .Values.appconfig.appPort }}'
          - name: PROVIDER_APP_ID
            value: '{{ .Values.appconfig.providerAppId }}'
          - name: INPUT_BINDING_NAME
            value: '{{ .Values.kafka.inputBindingName }}'
          - name: OUTPUT_BINDING_NAME
            value: '{{ .Values.kafka.outputBindingName }}'
          - name: DATABASE_TYPE
            value: 'POSTGRES'
          - name: DB_HOST
            value: '{{ .Values.database.host }}'
          - name: DB_NAME
            value: '{{ .Values.database.name }}'
          - name: DB_USERNAME
            value: '{{ .Values.database.username }}'
          - name: DB_PASSWORD
            valueFrom:
              secretKeyRef:
                name: mesx-{{ .Values.env }}-database-password
                key: password
          - name: DB_SYNC
            value: "false"
          - name: SECRET_STORE_NAME
            value: '{{ .Values.secrets.secretStoreName }}'
          - name: MII_API_PASSWORD_SECRET_NAME
            value: '{{ .Values.secrets.miiUserSecretName }}'
          livenessProbe:
            initialDelaySeconds: 5
            timeoutSeconds: 20
            httpGet:
              path: /
              port: {{ .Values.appconfig.appPort }}
          readinessProbe:
            initialDelaySeconds: 5
            timeoutSeconds: 20
            httpGet:
              path: /
              port: {{ .Values.appconfig.appPort }}
          resources:
            limits:
              cpu: "0.25"  # Reduced from 0.5
              memory: "128Mi"  # Reduced from 256Mi
            requests:
              cpu: "0.1"  # Reduced from 0.25
              memory: "64Mi"  # Reduced from 128Mi

apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: Ingress
metadata:
  name: 'mesx-{{ .Values.env }}-edge-api-proto'
  labels:
    app: 'mesx'
    chart: 'mesx-edge-api-proto'
    release: {{ .Release.Name }}
    component: mesx-common
spec:
  ingressClassName: traefik

apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: Job
metadata:
  name: mesx-{{ .Values.env }}-edge-proto-dbm-{{ (uuidv4 | split "-")._0 }}
  labels:
    app: 'mesx'
    chart: 'mesx-edge-api-proto'
    release: {{ .Release.Name }}
    component: edge-proto-dbm
  annotations:  
    argocd.argoproj.io/hook-delete-policy: HookSucceeded
    argocd.argoproj.io/hook: Sync
spec:
  ttlSecondsAfterFinished: 43200 # 12 hours
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: 'mesx'
        release: {{ .Release.Name }}
        component: edge-proto-dbm
    spec:
      serviceAccountName: {{ .Values.serviceAccount }}
      containers:
      - name: migration-job
        image: "{{ .Values.image }}:{{ pluck .Values.env .Values.serviceVersions.edge_api_proto | first | default .Values.serviceVersions.edge_api_proto.dev }}"
        imagePullPolicy: Always
        command: ["npm"]
        args: ["run", "typeorm:migrate-only"]
        env:
        - name: DB_HOST
          value: '{{ .Values.database.host }}'
        - name: DB_NAME
          value: '{{ .Values.database.name }}'
        - name: DB_USERNAME
          value: '{{ .Values.database.username }}'
        - name: DB_PASSWORD
          valueFrom:
            secretKeyRef:
              name: mesx-{{ .Values.env }}-database-password
              key: password
        - name: DB_SYNC
          value: "false"
        resources:
          requests:
            memory: "128Mi"
            cpu: "250m"
          limits:
            memory: "256Mi"
            cpu: "500m"
      restartPolicy: Never
  backoffLimit: 4

apiVersion: v1

  displayName: Job Name

  displayName: Processing Chunk Size
  type: string
  default: '1000'

  displayName: Field To Be Checked
  type: string
  default: ' '
- name: mode
  displayName: Materialized View Update Mode
  type: string
  default: FULL
  values:
  - FULL
  - INCREMENT

  type: string

  displayName: Processing Date Time To

  displayName: Processing Date Time Period

  default: true

trigger: none

pool: ubuntu-2204-vmss-mesx

steps:
- task: AzureCLI@2
  displayName: Configure az cli error output
  inputs:
    azureSubscription: ${{ parameters.azureSubscription}}
    scriptType: 'bash'
    scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
    inlineScript: |
      az config set core.only_show_errors=yes
    failOnStandardError: false

- task: AzureCLI@2
  displayName: Run Materialized View Update Job 
  inputs:
    azureSubscription: ${{ parameters.azureSubscription}}
    scriptType: 'pscore'
    scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
    inlineScript: |
      function Get-ResourceGroupName {
        param (
          [string]$jobName
        )
        $environment = $jobName.split('-')[3]
        
        $resourceGroupName = "rg-gptmpxn01-dev-eun-mes-01"
        
        if ($environment -eq "pro") {
          $resourceGroupName = "rg-gptmpxp01-pro-euw-mes-01"
        } elseif ($environment -eq "ppr") {
          $resourceGroupName = "rg-gptmpxp01-ppr-eun-mes-01"
        }

        return $resourceGroupName
      }
      
      function Set-EnvironmentVariableValue {
        param (
          [Array] $envs,
          [string]$name,
          [string]$newValue
        )
        Write-Output "- Setting environment variable '$name' to '$newValue'"
        $kv = $envs `
          | Where-Object { $_.name -eq $name } `
          | Select-Object -First 1
        
        $kv.value = $newValue -eq ' ' ? '' : $newValue
      }

      $jobName = "${{ parameters.jobName }}"
      
      $resourceGroupName = Get-ResourceGroupName $jobName
      
      Write-Host "Using azureSubscription '${{ parameters.azureSubscription}}'"

      try {
        Write-Output " - Reading job '$jobName' from resource group '$resourceGroupName'..."
        $caj = az containerapp job show --name $jobName `
          --resource-group $resourceGroupName `
          --query "properties.template" --output json `
          | ConvertFrom-Json -Depth 10

        Write-Output "Setting environment variables..."
        Set-EnvironmentVariableValue `
          -envs $caj.containers[0].env `
          -name "CHUNK" `
          -newValue "${{ parameters.chunkSize }}"
        
        Set-EnvironmentVariableValue `
          -envs $caj.containers[0].env `
          -name "FIELD_TO_BE_CHECKED" `
          -newValue "${{ parameters.fieldToBeChecked }}"

        Set-EnvironmentVariableValue `
          -envs $caj.containers[0].env `
          -name "MODE" `
          -newValue "${{ parameters.mode }}"

        Set-EnvironmentVariableValue `
          -envs $caj.containers[0].env `
          -name "PLANT" `
          -newValue "${{ parameters.plant }}"

        Set-EnvironmentVariableValue `
          -envs $caj.containers[0].env `
          -name "PROCESS_DATETIME_FROM" `
          -newValue "${{ parameters.processDateTimeFrom }}"

        Set-EnvironmentVariableValue `
          -envs $caj.containers[0].env `
          -name "PROCESS_DATETIME_TO" `
          -newValue "${{ parameters.processDateTimeTo }}"

        Set-EnvironmentVariableValue `
          -envs $caj.containers[0].env `
          -name "PROCESSING_PERIOD" `
          -newValue "${{ parameters.processingPeriod }}"

        $caj `
          | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10 `
          | Out-File -FilePath ./spec.json -Encoding utf8

        Write-Output "Triggering job '$jobName'..."
        
        az containerapp job start `
          --name $jobName `
          --no-wait `
          --resource-group $resourceGroupName `
          --yaml ./spec.json

        Write-Output "Job triggered successfully"
      }
      finally {
        if (Test-Path ./spec.json) {
          Remove-Item -Path ./spec.json -Verbose -Force
        }
      }
      
    failOnStandardError: ${{ parameters.failOnStandardError }}

- name: azureSubscription
  type: string
- name: pipelineDeploymentEnvironment
  type: string
- name: containerAppName
  type: string
- name: containerAppResourceGroupName
  type: string
- name: migrationContainerAppJobName
  type: string
  default: ''
- name: waitMigrationJob
  type: boolean
  default: true
- name: jobPool
  default: ubuntu-2204-vmss-mesx
- name: failOnStandardError
  default: true

jobs:
- deployment: deploy_container_app_${{ parameters.pipelineDeploymentEnvironment }}
  displayName: deploy to ${{ parameters.pipelineDeploymentEnvironment }}
  pool: ${{ parameters.jobPool }}
  environment: ${{ parameters.pipelineDeploymentEnvironment }}
  workspace:
    clean: all
  strategy:
      runOnce:
        deploy:
          steps:
          - task: AzureCLI@2
            displayName: Configure az cli error output
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: ${{ parameters.azureSubscription }}
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                az config set core.only_show_errors=yes
              failOnStandardError: false

          - task: AzureCLI@2
            displayName: Deploy Container App 'latest' tag  
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: ${{ parameters.azureSubscription }}
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                ca='${{ parameters.containerAppName }}'
                rg='${{ parameters.containerAppResourceGroupName }}'
                
                rev=$(az containerapp show -n $ca -g $rg --query properties.latestRevisionName -o tsv)
                az containerapp revision restart -n $ca -g $rg --revision $rev
              failOnStandardError: ${{ parameters.failOnStandardError }}
          
          - ${{ if ne(parameters.migrationContainerAppJobName, '') }}:
            - task: AzureCLI@2
              displayName: Run '${{ parameters.migrationContainerAppJobName }}' Database Migration Job 
              inputs:
                azureSubscription: ${{ parameters.azureSubscription }}
                scriptType: 'bash'
                scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
                inlineScript: |
                  cajob='${{ parameters.migrationContainerAppJobName }}'
                  rg='${{ parameters.containerAppResourceGroupName }}'

                  name=$(az containerapp job start \
                      -n $cajob \
                      -g $rg \
                      --query name -o tsv)

                  echo "Launched container app Job execution '$name'"
 
                  wait=${{ parameters.waitMigrationJob }}

                  if [ "$wait" == "True" ]
                  then
                    jobstatus=$(az containerapp job execution show \
                      -n $cajob \
                      -g $rg \
                      --job-execution-name $name \
                      --query properties.status -o tsv)

                    running_status='Running'
                    unknown_status='Unknown'
                    success_status='Succeeded'

                    while [ "$jobstatus" == "$running_status" ] || [ "$jobstatus" == "$unknown_status" ]; do
                      echo "$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S') - Running..."
                      sleep 7
                      jobstatus=$(az containerapp job execution show \
                        -n $cajob \
                        -g $rg \
                        --job-execution-name $name \
                        --query properties.status -o tsv)
                    done

                    if [ "$jobstatus" != "$success_status" ]; then
                      echo "Migration Job did not complete successfully, status: $jobstatus"
                      echo "Please check the container app job logs"
                      exit 1
                    fi

                    echo "Migration Job completed successfully !"
                  fi
                  
                failOnStandardError: ${{ parameters.failOnStandardError }}

steps:
- task: AzureCLI@2
  displayName: Configure az cli error output
  inputs:
    azureSubscription: ${{ parameters.azureSubscription }}
    scriptType: bash
    scriptLocation: inlineScript
    inlineScript: |
      az config set core.only_show_errors=yes
    failOnStandardError: false

- task: AzureCLI@2
  displayName: "Check if Cosmos migration job exists"
  inputs:
    azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
    scriptType: pscore
    scriptLocation: inlineScript
    inlineScript: |
      $jobName = "cosmos-migration"
      $rg = "rg-gptmpxn01-dev-eun-mes-01"

      $exists = az containerapp job show --name $jobName --resource-group $rg --only-show-errors 2>$null
      if (-not $exists) {
        Write-Host "Job $jobName does not exist. Creating it..."
        az containerapp job create `
          --name $jobName `
          --resource-group $rg `
          --environment <your-container-app-env-name> `
          --image <your-image> `
          --replica-timeout 1800 `
          --trigger-type Manual `
          --cpu 0.5 --memory 1.0Gi
      } else {
        Write-Host "Job $jobName already exists."
      }

# Documentation Deployment Pipeline
# Automatically deploys generated markdown documentation to MES_X.0.wiki repository
# Triggered when documentation changes are pushed to main branch

trigger:
  branches:
    include:
      - main
  paths:
    include:
      - docs/**

pr: none

resources:
  repositories:
    - repository: mesx-wiki
      type: git
      name: MES_X.0/MES_X.0.wiki

pool: ubuntu-2204-vmss-mesx

variables:
  - name: wikiTargetFolder
    value: 'ai-generated-docs'
  - name: sourceDocsFolder
    value: 'docs'

steps:
  - checkout: self
    persistCredentials: true
    displayName: 'Checkout source repository'

  - checkout: mesx-wiki
    persistCredentials: true
    displayName: 'Checkout MES_X.0.wiki repository'

  - script: |
      echo "� Configuring git credentials and user information"
      git config --global user.email "mesx.pipeline@forvia.com"
      git config --global user.name "MES X.0 Pipeline"
      git config --global credential.helper store
      echo "✅ Git configuration completed"
    displayName: 'Configure git credentials'

  - script: |
      echo "�🚀 Starting documentation deployment process"
      echo "Source branch: $(Build.SourceBranch)"
      echo "Build reason: $(Build.Reason)"
      echo "Repository: $(Build.Repository.Name)"
      echo "Commit: $(Build.SourceVersion)"
    displayName: 'Display pipeline context'

  - script: |
      echo "📁 Checking source documentation structure"
      echo "🔍 Current working directory: $(pwd)"
      echo "🔍 Pipeline workspace: $(Pipeline.Workspace)"
      echo "🔍 Build sources directory: $(Build.SourcesDirectory)"
      echo "🔍 Looking for docs in: $(Build.SourcesDirectory)/mesx-proto-docs-gen/$(sourceDocsFolder)"
      
      if [ -d "$(Build.SourcesDirectory)/mesx-proto-docs-gen/$(sourceDocsFolder)" ]; then
        echo "✅ Documentation folder found"
        find "$(Build.SourcesDirectory)/mesx-proto-docs-gen/$(sourceDocsFolder)" -name "*.md" -type f
        echo "📊 Total markdown files found:"
        find "$(Build.SourcesDirectory)/mesx-proto-docs-gen/$(sourceDocsFolder)" -name "*.md" -type f | wc -l
      else
        echo "❌ Documentation folder not found at $(Build.SourcesDirectory)/mesx-proto-docs-gen/$(sourceDocsFolder)"
        echo "🔍 Available directories in source:"
        ls -la "$(Build.SourcesDirectory)/"
        echo "🔍 Available directories in mesx-proto-docs-gen:"
        ls -la "$(Build.SourcesDirectory)/mesx-proto-docs-gen/" || echo "mesx-proto-docs-gen directory not found"
        exit 1
      fi
    displayName: 'Validate source documentation'

  - script: |
      cd "$(Build.SourcesDirectory)/MES_X.0.wiki"
      echo "📂 Creating target directory structure in wiki"
      
      # Create ai-generated-docs folder if it doesn't exist
      if [ ! -d "$(wikiTargetFolder)" ]; then
        mkdir -p "$(wikiTargetFolder)"
        echo "✅ Created $(wikiTargetFolder) directory"
      else
        echo "📁 $(wikiTargetFolder) directory already exists"
      fi
      
      # Create subdirectories to match source structure
      mkdir -p "$(wikiTargetFolder)/services"
      mkdir -p "$(wikiTargetFolder)/controllers"
      mkdir -p "$(wikiTargetFolder)/entities"
      mkdir -p "$(wikiTargetFolder)/modules"
      mkdir -p "$(wikiTargetFolder)/dtos"
      mkdir -p "$(wikiTargetFolder)/integrations"
      mkdir -p "$(wikiTargetFolder)/configs"
      
      echo "✅ Directory structure created"
      ls -la "$(wikiTargetFolder)/"
    displayName: 'Setup wiki directory structure'

  - script: |
      echo "📋 Copying documentation files to wiki repository"
      echo "🔍 Source path: $(Build.SourcesDirectory)/mesx-proto-docs-gen/$(sourceDocsFolder)"
      echo "🔍 Target path: $(Build.SourcesDirectory)/MES_X.0.wiki/$(wikiTargetFolder)"
      
      # Copy all markdown files from docs folder to wiki
      if [ -d "$(Build.SourcesDirectory)/mesx-proto-docs-gen/$(sourceDocsFolder)" ]; then
        cp -r "$(Build.SourcesDirectory)/mesx-proto-docs-gen/$(sourceDocsFolder)"/* "$(Build.SourcesDirectory)/MES_X.0.wiki/$(wikiTargetFolder)/"
        echo "✅ Documentation files copied successfully"
        
        echo "📊 Files copied to wiki:"
        find "$(Build.SourcesDirectory)/MES_X.0.wiki/$(wikiTargetFolder)" -name "*.md" -type f
      else
        echo "❌ Source documentation folder not found"
        exit 1
      fi
    displayName: 'Copy documentation to wiki'

  - script: |
      cd "$(Build.SourcesDirectory)/MES_X.0.wiki"
      
      echo "📝 Creating documentation index if it doesn't exist"
      if [ ! -f "$(wikiTargetFolder)/README.md" ]; then
        cat > "$(wikiTargetFolder)/README.md" << 'EOF'
      # AI-Generated Documentation
      
      This folder contains automatically generated documentation from the MES-X prototype documentation generation system.
      
      ## Structure
      
      - **services/**: Business logic service documentation
      - **controllers/**: API endpoint documentation  
      - **entities/**: Database schema documentation
      - **modules/**: Module configuration documentation
      - **dtos/**: Data transfer object documentation
      - **integrations/**: External service integration documentation
      - **configs/**: Configuration documentation
      
      ## Generation Info
      
      - **Last Updated**: $(date -u +"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S UTC")
      - **Source Repository**: mesx-proto-docs-gen
      - **Build**: $(Build.BuildNumber)
      - **Commit**: $(Build.SourceVersion)
      
      ---
      *This documentation is automatically generated and updated via Azure DevOps pipeline.*
      EOF
        echo "✅ Created documentation index"
      else
        echo "📄 Documentation index already exists, updating timestamp"
        sed -i "s/- \*\*Last Updated\*\*:.*/- **Last Updated**: $(date -u +"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S UTC")/" "$(wikiTargetFolder)/README.md"
        sed -i "s/- \*\*Build\*\*:.*/- **Build**: $(Build.BuildNumber)/" "$(wikiTargetFolder)/README.md"
        sed -i "s/- \*\*Commit\*\*:.*/- **Commit**: $(Build.SourceVersion)/" "$(wikiTargetFolder)/README.md"
      fi
    displayName: 'Create/update documentation index'

  - script: |
      echo "🔧 Pre-push debugging information"
      echo "📍 Current working directory: $(pwd)"
      echo "📍 Available repositories:"
      find "$(Build.SourcesDirectory)" -name ".git" -type d
      echo "📍 Wiki repository status:"
      cd "$(Build.SourcesDirectory)/MES_X.0.wiki"
      pwd
      echo "📍 Git status:"
      git status
      echo "📍 Current branch/HEAD:"
      git branch -a
      echo "📍 Remote configuration:"
      git remote -v
      echo "📍 Remote branches:"
      git ls-remote --heads origin
      echo "📍 Git configuration:"
      git config --list | grep -E "(user|credential)" || echo "No user/credential config found"
      echo "📍 Files in ai-generated-docs:"
      ls -la ai-generated-docs/ 2>/dev/null || echo "ai-generated-docs directory not found"
    displayName: 'Debug repository state'

  - script: |
      cd "$(Build.SourcesDirectory)/MES_X.0.wiki"
      
      echo "🔍 Checking for changes in wiki repository"
      git status --porcelain
      
      if [ -n "$(git status --porcelain)" ]; then
        echo "📝 Changes detected, preparing commit"
        
        # Stage all changes
        git add .
        
        # Create commit message with details
        COMMIT_MSG="📚 Auto-update documentation from mesx-proto-docs-gen

        Pipeline: $(Build.DefinitionName)
        Build: $(Build.BuildNumber)
        Source Commit: $(Build.SourceVersion)
        Triggered by: $(Build.RequestedFor)
        Date: $(date -u +"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S UTC")
        
        Updated documentation files:
        $(git diff --cached --name-only | head -10)
        $([ $(git diff --cached --name-only | wc -l) -gt 10 ] && echo "... and $(( $(git diff --cached --name-only | wc -l) - 10 )) more files")"
        
        echo "💾 Committing changes with message:"
        echo "$COMMIT_MSG"
        
        git commit -m "$COMMIT_MSG"
        
        echo "🚀 Pushing changes to wiki repository"
        
        # Handle detached HEAD state - create/switch to proper branch
        echo "📍 Handling detached HEAD state and determining target branch"
        
        # Get all remote branches to understand the repository structure
        echo "📍 Available remote branches:"
        git ls-remote --heads origin
        
        # For Azure DevOps wiki, determine the correct branch
        # Most wikis use either the default branch or 'wikiMaster'
        REMOTE_BRANCHES=$(git ls-remote --heads origin | awk '{print $2}' | sed 's|refs/heads/||')
        echo "📍 Remote branches found: $REMOTE_BRANCHES"
        
        # Determine target branch priority: wikiMaster > master > main > first available
        TARGET_BRANCH=""
        for BRANCH in "wikiMaster" "master" "main"; do
          if echo "$REMOTE_BRANCHES" | grep -q "^${BRANCH}$"; then
            TARGET_BRANCH="$BRANCH"
            echo "📍 Found preferred branch: $TARGET_BRANCH"
            break
          fi
        done
        
        # If no preferred branch found, use the first available
        if [ -z "$TARGET_BRANCH" ]; then
          TARGET_BRANCH=$(echo "$REMOTE_BRANCHES" | head -n1)
          echo "📍 Using first available branch: $TARGET_BRANCH"
        fi
        
        # Create and switch to the target branch
        echo "📍 Creating/switching to branch: $TARGET_BRANCH"
        git checkout -B "$TARGET_BRANCH"
        
        # Verify we're on the correct branch and have changes
        echo "📍 Current branch: $(git branch --show-current)"
        echo "📍 Files to be pushed:"
        git status --porcelain
        
        # Push to the target branch
        echo "📍 Pushing to branch: $TARGET_BRANCH"
        if git push origin "$TARGET_BRANCH"; then
          echo "✅ Successfully pushed to $TARGET_BRANCH"
        else
          echo "❌ Push failed. Attempting with force (this may be necessary for wiki repos):"
          if git push origin "$TARGET_BRANCH" --force; then
            echo "✅ Successfully force-pushed to $TARGET_BRANCH"
          else
            echo "❌ All push attempts failed. Final diagnostics:"
            git status
            git remote -v
            echo "📍 Checking if remote branch exists:"
            git ls-remote origin "$TARGET_BRANCH" || echo "Remote branch does not exist"
            exit 1
          fi
        fi
        
        echo "✅ Documentation successfully deployed to wiki"
      else
        echo "ℹ️ No changes detected in documentation"
      fi
    displayName: 'Commit and push documentation updates'

  - script: |
      echo "📊 Deployment Summary:"
      echo "======================================"
      echo "✅ Pipeline completed successfully"
      echo "📁 Target wiki folder: $(wikiTargetFolder)"
      echo "🔗 Wiki repository: MES_X.0.wiki"
      echo "📋 Documentation files processed:"
      find "$(Build.SourcesDirectory)/MES_X.0.wiki/$(wikiTargetFolder)" -name "*.md" -type f | wc -l
      echo "⏰ Deployment time: $(date -u +"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S UTC")"
      echo "======================================"
    displayName: 'Display deployment summary'

        - task: NuGetAuthenticate@1

        - script: dotnet nuget list source

          inputs:
            packageType: 'sdk'
            version: '8.x'

        - task: DotNetCoreCLI@2
          displayName: 'Restore NuGet packages'
          inputs:
            command: 'restore'
            projects: '**/*.sln'
            feedsToUse: 'config'
            nugetConfigPath: 'Nuget.config'
            
            
      step_postPrepare:
        - template: steps/dotnet-restore-build-test.yml@pipelines
          parameters:
            run_tests: false
            dotnetVersion: "8.x"

      prepare_sonarAdditionalProperties: |
        sonar.cs.vstest.reportsPaths=$(Agent.TempDirectory)/**/*.trx
        sonar.coverage.exclusions=**/Migrations/*.cs,**/*Tests*/**/*
        sonar.cs.opencover.reportsPaths=**/coverage.opencover.xml
        sonar.cpd.exclusions=**/Migrations/*.cs
        sonar.issue.ignore.multicriteria=useconstant,emptymethod
        sonar.issue.ignore.multicriteria.useconstant.ruleKey=csharpsquid:S1192
        sonar.issue.ignore.multicriteria.useconstant.resourceKey=**/Migrations/*.cs
        sonar.issue.ignore.multicriteria.emptymethod.ruleKey=csharpsquid:S1186
        sonar.issue.ignore.multicriteria.emptymethod.resourceKey=**/Migrations/*.cs

import { KanbanData } from '../../wk-integration/interfaces/kanban-data.interface.dto';

/**
 * Convert a buffer line (from Order API) to KanbanData format for revalidation.
 * The KanbanData interface uses PascalCase property names by design (XML mapping).
 * @param bufferLine - The buffer line object from Order API
 * @returns KanbanData compatible with validateAndAssign
 */
export const bufferLineToKanbanData = (
  bufferLine: Record<string, unknown>,
): KanbanData => ({
  Action: (bufferLine.actionType as string) ?? undefined,
  Batch: (bufferLine.batch as string) ?? undefined,
  BatchTest: (bufferLine.batchTest as string) ?? undefined,
  CalendarType1: (bufferLine.calendarType1 as string) ?? undefined,
  CalendarType2: (bufferLine.calendarType2 as string) ?? undefined,
  CalendarType3: (bufferLine.calendarType3 as string) ?? undefined,
  CalendarType4: (bufferLine.calendarType4 as string) ?? undefined,
  CalendarType5: (bufferLine.calendarType5 as string) ?? undefined,
  CalendarType6: (bufferLine.calendarType6 as string) ?? undefined,
  Customer: (bufferLine.customer as string) ?? undefined,
  DeliveryNumber: (bufferLine.deliveryNumber as string) ?? undefined,
  DestinationLocation: (bufferLine.destinationLocation as string) ?? undefined,
  EndPickingDateTime: (bufferLine.endPickingDatetime as string) ?? undefined,
  EndPreparationDateTime:
    (bufferLine.endPreparationDatetime as string) ?? undefined,
  EndProductionDateTime:
    (bufferLine.endProductionDatetime as string) ?? undefined,
  LaunchingDateTime: (bufferLine.launchDatetime as string) ?? undefined,
  MaterialNumber: (bufferLine.materialNumber as string) ?? undefined,
  OrderID: (bufferLine.orderId as string) ?? undefined,
  ProductionLine: (bufferLine.productionLine as string) ?? undefined,
  ProductionLineUPstream:
    (bufferLine.productionLineUpstream as string) ?? undefined,
  Quantity: (bufferLine.quantity as number) ?? undefined,
  SourceLocation: (bufferLine.sourceLocation as string) ?? undefined,
  StartPickingDateTime:
    (bufferLine.startPickingDatetime as string) ?? undefined,
  StartProductionDateTime:
    (bufferLine.startProductionDatetime as string) ?? undefined,
  TPANumber: (bufferLine.tpaNumber as string) ?? undefined,
  TruckDepartureDateTime:
    (bufferLine.truckDepartureDatetime as string) ?? undefined,
  UpstreamMaterial: (bufferLine.upstreamMaterial as string) ?? undefined,
});
